checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The basic services includesText names arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
No other mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears; the only overhead fee described is the basic services fee.
D-embalming is printed on page 1 and the Embalming price is on page 1, so it is on the same page and adjacent block basis.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service; the embalming disclosure describes viewing arrangements only.
D-alt-container is printed on page 2 and the direct cremation range is on page 2, so it is on the same page as the direct cremation prices.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container, fiberboard container, and unfinished wood box options, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description lists transportation to crematory and cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own lines, and no goods or services are mentioned only inside a package, description or policy.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not treated as packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase; the only law-related statements are the required not-required disclosures.
No text claims that a product delays decomposition long-term or protects the body from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and the required disclosures are presented in full clear sentences.
